source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in 31 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W11819775B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics active. Use ▲/▼ to reach the test number for this procedure; Freezer to enter.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 25
steps.body: In Service Diagnostic Mode use ▲/▼ to reach step 25. Press Freezer button to enter test. Amber step number; result on display.

steps.title: Cycle damper
steps.body: Select on/oF — damper cycles open/closed while fan runs. Modes 00=closed, 01=open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select on/oF — damper cycles open/closed while fan runs. Modes 00=closed, 01=open.

steps.title: Damper opens and closes
steps.body: CN7 stepper pins = 6.3 VDC while moving. Does damper cycle?
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN7 stepper pins = 6.3 VDC while moving. Does damper cycle?

steps.title: Replace RC damper
steps.oemOutcome: Replace damper assembly when it fails to move in test 25.

steps.title: Damper verified
steps.oemOutcome: RC damper cycles correctly in service test 25.
